question: 按 category.name 返回该类别电影的不同租赁rental_id数量和不同actor_id人数；演员关系会扇出租赁记录，两种去重计数都必须正确。

returned_proposal_or_review.sql:
WITH category_film AS (
    SELECT fc.category_id, fc.film_id
    FROM film_category AS fc
), category_rentals AS (
    SELECT cf.category_id, r.rental_id
    FROM category_film AS cf
    JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = cf.film_id
    JOIN rental AS r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
), rental_counts AS (
    SELECT cr.category_id, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.rental_id) AS distinct_rental_count
    FROM category_rentals AS cr
    GROUP BY cr.category_id
), category_actors AS (
    SELECT cf.category_id, fa.actor_id
    FROM category_film AS cf
    JOIN film_actor AS fa ON fa.film_id = cf.film_id
), actor_counts AS (
    SELECT ca.category_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.actor_id) AS distinct_actor_count
    FROM category_actors AS ca
    GROUP BY ca.category_id
)
SELECT c.name AS category_name,
       COALESCE(rc.distinct_rental_count, 0) AS distinct_rental_count,
       COALESCE(ac.distinct_actor_count, 0) AS distinct_actor_count
FROM category AS c
LEFT JOIN rental_counts AS rc ON rc.category_id = c.category_id
LEFT JOIN actor_counts AS ac ON ac.category_id = c.category_id

SELECT c.name AS category_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT r.rental_id) AS distinct_rental_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT fa.actor_id) AS distinct_actor_count
FROM category AS c
LEFT JOIN film_category AS fc ON fc.category_id = c.category_id
LEFT JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = fc.film_id
LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
LEFT JOIN rental AS r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
LEFT JOIN film_actor AS fa ON fa.film_id = f.film_id
GROUP BY c.name

returned_proposal_or_review.clarification: SQL按类别名称分组，并用DISTINCT分别计数租赁ID和演员ID，能抵消演员与租赁连接造成的扇出。但它把没有匹配记录的类别计为0；题目未规定这种填零规则，且SQLite原生COUNT在LEFT JOIN形成的空匹配组上本来就返回0。更关键的是，按name分组会合并具有相同名称的不同category记录；题目要求按category.name返回，但未说明同名类别应合并还是分别列出。请确认同名类别的处理方式，并保留SQLite原生NULL/零语义，不要另行改变计数结果。
